title: showroom
summary: This entry announces the opening of the Très Bonjour showroom and atelier in Berlin. Located at Torstrasse 3, the showroom offers fashion and design items. It provides contact information and opening hours for visitors.
excerpt: Discover the new Très Bonjour showroom and atelier, opening on January 24th at Torstrasse 3 in Berlin. Explore unique fashion and design pieces, and find all the details for your visit, including contact information and opening hours.
